artifacts.name: raw_intent.json
artifacts.purpose: Preserve the exact request, source, context references, attachments, and text hash.

artifacts.name: intent_ir.json
artifacts.purpose: Normalize goals, outcomes, constraints, ambiguities, conflicts, and unknowns with RawIntent grounding.

artifacts.name: intent_validation.json
artifacts.purpose: Record deterministic reference, identifier, span, and controlled-value checks.

artifacts.name: intent_fidelity.json
artifacts.purpose: Record whether normalized meaning is supported by the referenced RawIntent.

artifacts.name: requirement_ir.json
artifacts.purpose: Compile accepted intent into workflow-independent requirements with acceptance and evidence specifications.

artifacts.name: requirement_validation.json
artifacts.purpose: Record requirement reference, acceptance, evidence, verification, and dependency checks.

artifacts.name: requirement_coverage.json
artifacts.purpose: Prove that every IntentIR item is represented by one or more requirements.

artifacts.name: compilation_trace.json
artifacts.purpose: Bind compiler stages and immutable artifact hashes.

design_support.name: field_consumer_matrix.json
design_support.purpose: Require every semantic field to drive a concrete downstream decision or integrity check.

design_support.name: generalization_cases.json
design_support.purpose: Exercise the artifact design across diverse prompt and planner-strategy classes.

design_support.name: validate_contract_examples.py
design_support.purpose: Deterministically validate the committed metadata examples.
